description: Canonical temporal contract for financial observations, serving releases, and point-in-time queries.

iso_utc.description: RFC3339 UTC instant ending in Z.

epoch_ns.description: Signed integer nanoseconds since Unix epoch; never derived through floating point.

clocks.event_time: When the underlying economic or market event occurred; period_end is not event_time.
clocks.published_at: When the source publicly published the information.
clocks.available_at: Earliest instant at which a PIT query may expose the observation.
clocks.ingested_at: When this infrastructure received or persisted the record; backfill ingestion must not simulate historical availability.

as_of.rule: An observation is eligible exactly when available_at <= as_of after UTC normalization.

date_policy: Calendar dates remain YYYY-MM-DD semantic dates and are never implicitly converted to midnight UTC.
dst_policy: Named timezone local civil times that are nonexistent or ambiguous without an explicit offset/fold are rejected.
session_policy: US equities session_date is market-local calendar metadata and is not derived from UTC timestamp date.
derived_policy: derived.available_at is the maximum normalized available_at of all inputs and retains input evidence IDs and calculation ID.
